_comment: TEMPLATE. Copy to ideation_config.json beside this file and fill in the three <...> credentials; that copy is gitignored and must never be committed. Anything already exported in the shell wins over the value here, so configure by `export VAR=...` rather than by editing. Loaded by p1_env.sh; point IDEATION_CONFIG at another file to swap the whole set. MECHANIC_DB_TOP_K is the TOTAL retrieval budget the service splits across the databases in MECHANIC_DB_TARGET_DBS (300 -> 150 each); MECHANIC_DB_MAX_RESULTS_PER_DB is how many survive the rerank PER DATABASE (15 -> 30 papers reach the prompt).
